Loading in data and setting up environment
```{r}

rm(list = ls()) # clears environment

library(readr)
library(tidyverse)

data <- read_csv("health_fitness_dataset.csv") 

```

Filtering for rows where `health_condition` = Diabetes
```{r}
diabetes_data <- data %>%
  filter(health_condition == "Diabetes")


```
